en.basel-kadem: 1.	We were told by Ahmad bin Hasan al-Qattan, that he said: We were told by Abdul-Rahman bin Muhammed al-Hussaini, that he said: We were told by Abu Ja’far, Ahmad bin Isa bin Abi Maryam al-‘Ajali, that he said: We were told by Muhammed bin Ahmad bin Abdullah bin Ziyad al-‘Azrami, that he said: I was told by Ali bin Hatem al-Manqari, from Hisham bin Salim, that he said: I asked Abu Abdillah, peace be upon him,
about the saying of Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He: «And We place the Scales of Justice for the Day of Resurrection, and so no soul shall be treated unjustly at all.» [21:47]
He said: They are the Prophets and Successors, peace be upon them.
